description: One bounded monitoring check of a procurement procedure from any of its TED notices: the current fingerprint of its watched state (notices in the procedure, stage, lot deadlines, estimated value, winners and award value), changed true or false against the fingerprint you kept, and what differs from YRUZ's previous observation, so a new corrigendum, a moved deadline or a published award is caught. No subscription: each check is one paid call. Price: 0.003 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. How to call it: get_example {"tool":"tenders_monitor_check"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/tenders/monitor?id=685949-2026

fingerprint.description: fingerprint returned by your previous check (optional)

id.description: TED publication number of a notice of the procedure (required)
